title: New Health Insurance Scheme for Pensioners / Family Pensioners – Tamil Nadu Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health insurance programme for eligible Tamil Nadu government pensioners and family pensioners and their covered dependants.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Tamil Nadu government pensioners/family pensioners and covered family members under the current pensioner NHIS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under New Health Insurance Scheme for Pensioners / Family Pensioners – Tamil Nadu.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
